def verify_golomb_ruler(marks):
    """Verify that a set of marks forms a valid Golomb ruler."""
    distances = set()
    for i in range(len(marks)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(marks)):
            d = marks[j] - marks[i]
            if d in distances:
                return False, f"Duplicate distance: {d}"
            distances.add(d)
    return True, f"Valid Golomb ruler with {len(distances)} unique distances"
